shared_findings.raw_predicate_semantics: finite extensional source-fact incidence only; all conditional force is supplied by Core NOT/IMPLIES/AND

items.source_body: W04e says the author's interpretation is still changing and therefore later claims must remain revision-scoped.
W03 is mutable project-status evidence and cannot overwrite frozen source revisions without an explicit successor target.
items.guard: No explicit successor target is asserted to exist; only the source's necessary condition on overwrite is represented.

items.source_body: The July-2026 W03 status explicitly says the current notes are work in progress, are unlikely to be updated in place, and a future write-up is expected to differ significantly; mutable status evidence therefore cannot retroactively rewrite W01/W02.
items.reconstruction: DEFINITION_EXPANDS_TO(body, AND(work_in_progress, unlikely_update_in_place, dated_July_2026, future_writeup_differs, IMPLIES(AND(those facts), NOT(retroactively_rewrites(W01_W02)))))

items.source_body: The linked W04e notes are a preliminary version dated 2026-07-14, while the author-maintained W03/W04e status explicitly says the interpretation is still changing and a later account is expected to differ substantially; the preliminary notes therefore remain revision-scoped.
items.reconstruction: DEFINITION_EXPANDS_TO(body, AND(preliminary, exact_date, changing_interpretation, later_account_differs, IMPLIES(AND(those facts), revision_scoped(notes))))
